# GGSEG3D VISUALIZE

## 0. Data and libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(corrplot)
library(BBmisc)
library(lmerTest)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(cluster)
library(stringr)
library(factoextra)
library(broom)
library(readxl)
library(performance)
library(emmeans)
library(influence.ME)
library(rstatix)
library(ggseg)
library(ggseg3d)
library(reticulate)
```

Load lobe summary:

```{r}
lobes <- read.csv("Output/Components_Lobes/summary_statistics.csv")
```

```{r}
K_lobes <- lobes[9:16,]
S_lobes <- lobes[41:48,]
I_lobes <- lobes[1:8,]

K_lobes <- K_lobes[,c("Region","Patient.Cohen.s.d")]
colnames(K_lobes) <- c("lobe","Patient_CohensD")

S_lobes <- S_lobes[,c("Region","Patient.Cohen.s.d")]
colnames(S_lobes) <- c("lobe","Patient_CohensD")

I_lobes <- I_lobes[,c("Region","Patient.Cohen.s.d")]
colnames(I_lobes) <- c("lobe","Patient_CohensD")
```

```{r}
lh_K_lobes <- K_lobes[1:4,]
rh_K_lobes <- K_lobes[5:8,]

lh_S_lobes <- S_lobes[1:4,]
rh_S_lobes <- S_lobes[5:8,]

lh_I_lobes <- I_lobes[1:4,]
rh_I_lobes <- I_lobes[5:8,]
```

Load regional summary:

```{r}
surface <- read.csv("Output/Area/summary_statistics.csv")
thickness <- read.csv("Output/Thickness/summary_statistics.csv")

surface <- surface[,c("Region","Patient.Cohen.s.d")]
colnames(surface) <- c("region","Patient_CohensD")
thickness <- thickness[,c("Region","Patient.Cohen.s.d")]
colnames(thickness) <- c("region","Patient_CohensD")
```

```{r}
lh_surface <- surface[1:34,]
rh_surface <- surface[35:68,]

lh_thickness <- thickness[1:34,]
rh_thickness <- thickness[35:68,]
```

## 1. Visualize Lobes

```{r}
lobe_map <- list(
  frontal = c(
    "caudal middle frontal",
    "lateral orbitofrontal",
    "medial orbitofrontal",
    "pars opercularis",
    "pars orbitalis",
    "pars triangularis",
    "precentral",
    "rostral middle frontal",
    "superior frontal",
    "frontal pole"
  ),
  
  parietal = c(
    "inferior parietal",
    "paracentral",
    "postcentral",
    "precuneus",
    "superior parietal",
    "supramarginal"
  ),
  
  temporal = c(
    "bankssts",
    "entorhinal",
    "fusiform",
    "inferior temporal",
    "middle temporal",
    "parahippocampal",
    "superior temporal",
    "temporal pole",
    "transverse temporal"
  ),
  
  occipital = c(
    "cuneus",
    "lateral occipital",
    "lingual",
    "pericalcarine"
  )
)
```

```{r}
atlas_lobe_left <- dk_3d %>%
  filter(surf == "inflated" & hemi == "left") %>%
  unnest(ggseg_3d) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(region) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(!region %in% c("corpus callosum")) # needs to be removed

atlas_lobe_right <- dk_3d %>%
  filter(surf == "inflated" & hemi == "right") %>%
  unnest(ggseg_3d) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(region) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(!region %in% c("corpus callosum")) # needs to be removed

atlas_lobe_left <- atlas_lobe_left %>%
  mutate(
    lobe = case_when(
      region %in% lobe_map$frontal ~ "frontal",
      region %in% lobe_map$temporal ~ "temporal",
      region %in% lobe_map$parietal ~ "parietal",
      region %in% lobe_map$occipital ~ "occipital",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(lobe))

atlas_lobe_right <- atlas_lobe_right %>%
  mutate(
    lobe = case_when(
      region %in% lobe_map$frontal ~ "frontal",
      region %in% lobe_map$temporal ~ "temporal",
      region %in% lobe_map$parietal ~ "parietal",
      region %in% lobe_map$occipital ~ "occipital",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(lobe))

atlas_lobe_left <- atlas_lobe_left %>%
  mutate(region_clean = region %>%
           tolower() %>%
           str_replace_all("[ _]", ""))

atlas_lobe_right <- atlas_lobe_right %>%
  mutate(region_clean = region %>%
           tolower() %>%
           str_replace_all("[ _]", ""))
```

### 1.1. K - Tension

Merge with z-scores: **IMPORTANT Your regions need to match with atlas_lobe!**

```{r}
lh_K_lobes <- lh_K_lobes %>%
  mutate(lobe = str_replace(lobe, "^K_|^K_", "")) %>%
  mutate(lobe = str_replace(lobe, "^left_|^right_", "")) %>%
  mutate(lobe = str_replace(lobe, "^.", tolower))

rh_K_lobes <- rh_K_lobes %>%
  mutate(lobe = str_replace(lobe, "^K_|^K_", "")) %>%
  mutate(lobe = str_replace(lobe, "^left_|^right_", "")) %>%
  mutate(lobe = str_replace(lobe, "^.", tolower))
```

```{r}
leftData <- merge(atlas_lobe_left,lh_K_lobes,by="lobe")
LeftData_PAT <- leftData[,c("region","Patient_CohensD")]

rightData <- merge(atlas_lobe_right,rh_K_lobes,by="lobe")
RightData_PAT <- rightData[,c("region","Patient_CohensD")]
```

#### 1.1.1. Left Hemisphere

```{r}
pat_LH_K_lobe_med <- ggseg3d(.data = LeftData_PAT,
        atlas = dk_3d,
        colour = "Patient_CohensD",
        text = "Patient_CohensD", na.colour = "white",
        palette = c("midnightblue" = -1, "deepskyblue1" = -0.5, "seashell" = 0, "orangered" = 0.5, "darkred" = 1)) %>% 
  pan_camera("left medial") %>% remove_axes()
pat_LH_K_lobe_med
```

```{r}
pat_LH_K_lobe_lat <- ggseg3d(.data = LeftData_PAT,
        atlas = dk_3d,
        colour = "Patient_CohensD",
        text = "Patient_CohensD", na.colour = "white",
        palette = c("midnightblue" = -1, "deepskyblue1" = -0.5, "seashell" = 0, "orangered" = 0.5, "darkred" = 1)) %>% 
  pan_camera("left lateral") %>% remove_axes() 
pat_LH_K_lobe_lat
```

#### 1.1.2. Right Hemisphere


## 2. Surface Area

Select atlas, which hemisphere, and how the surface needs to be presented:

```{r}
atlas_data_left <- dk_3d %>%
  filter(surf == "inflated" & hemi == "left") %>%
  unnest(ggseg_3d) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(region) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(!region %in% c("corpus callosum")) # needs to be removed

atlas_data_right <- dk_3d %>%
  filter(surf == "inflated" & hemi == "right") %>%
  unnest(ggseg_3d) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(region) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(!region %in% c("corpus callosum")) # needs to be removed
```

Make region_clean to match with atlas_data

```{r}
atlas_data_left <- atlas_data_left %>%
  mutate(region_clean = region %>%
           tolower() %>%
           str_replace_all("[ _]", ""))

atlas_data_right <- atlas_data_right %>%
  mutate(region_clean = region %>%
           tolower() %>%
           str_replace_all("[ _]", ""))
```

Merge data with our zscores. **IMPORTANT: Your regions need to match with atlas_data!**

```{r}
lh_surface <- lh_surface %>%
  # remove lh_ or rh_ prefix
  mutate(region = str_replace(region, "^lh_|^rh_", "")) %>%
  # remove _surface suffix
  mutate(region = str_replace(region, "_area$", ""))

rh_surface <- rh_surface %>%
  # remove lh_ or rh_ prefix
  mutate(region = str_replace(region, "^lh_|^rh_", "")) %>%
  # remove _surface suffix
  mutate(region = str_replace(region, "_area$", ""))
```

```{r}
leftData <- merge(atlas_data_left,lh_surface,by.x = "region_clean",by.y = "region")
LeftData_PAT <- leftData[,c("region","Patient_CohensD")]
```

```{r}
rightData <- merge(atlas_data_right,rh_surface,by.x = "region_clean",by.y = "region")
RightData_PAT <- rightData[,c("region","Patient_CohensD")]
```
